item.title: Wlkata Mirobot Robotic Arm Control
item.description: A ROS2 control stack for a physical 6-axis Wlkata Mirobot arm, built up from joint commands to an optimization-based inverse kinematics solver and pure pursuit tracking of paths the user draws.
